name: Feasibility: Addons — business
description:
Owner per PRD: Addons team.

As-Is: web managed via CRM / API Partner Services; all edits go through the API team or Green team; the administrative part is managed manually by the Marketplace team.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Form for requesting a new add-on → Salesforce
- Add-on request wishlist
- "My add-ons" overview — status, remaining time, deep link
- List of legal contracts for add-ons
- Commissions dashboard

h2. To analyse

- Integration with internal CRM — who will have editing rights and what the approval process is (OQ-11)
- Salesforce intake path: 123FormBuilder vs. native portal forms writing into SF
- Where add-on metadata and status are mastered (CRM vs. Salesforce vs. Marketplace)
- Commission data source and calculation
- Overlap with Invoicing and Addons — stats & dashboards

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
